items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: I heard him a couple of times, not too much, but he was a, you know, corner player

ctx.x: And Bung Johnson. Yeah. How was Freddie Kemper? Did you hear him much?

I heard him a couple of times, not too much, but he was a, you know, corner player, he played something like, high up above the staff. Everything was high he played. He never was no sweet corner player. Yeah.
Bung was sort of a sweet.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Look, Papa had the Sapera band. He played with nobody. That was with Freddie Capit.

ctx.x: From the first band on. Look, Papa had the Sapera band. He played with nobody. That was with Freddie Capit. Sapera. The Empire. The Empire. And Olympia. That was the Bunk Johnson. And the Olympia. The Bunk Johnson up on Rampart and Gradient.
That's all in there. You got it again? That's all in there.
